name: Summit League Cross Country Championships
where: St. Paul, MN · host St. Thomas
headline: Summit League Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: North Dakota won the women's title with 22 points to South Dakota's 60 and North Dakota State's 67, with Shewaye Johnson taking the individual win in 20:30.0. South Dakota State won the men's title with 34 points to North Dakota's 45 and South Dakota's 83, while Oral Roberts' Abraham Chelangam won the race in 23:43.6.
